sara_docs: Quick sync - I'm polishing the "Rate limits & Billing tiers" doc and noticed three things that should land together in one PR.
miguel: lay them out and we'll split tasks.
sara_docs: 1) examples show quota units as "tokens" but our billing uses "units" for embeddings/compute; needs clarification + a migration note for existing customers.
sara_docs: 2) rate limit error payloads changed recently. Current snippet only shows `retry_after` (s). New runtime emits `retry_after_ms`. Need to show both and recommend `retry_after_ms`.
sara_docs: 3) dashboard links and screenshots are stale — the new metering dashboards show per-tier usage and a new graph `requests_per_tier`. Update images or swap to SVGs.
tara_support: Support is seeing confusion about billing units. If you add a small conversion table (tokens -> units for gen, embedding units per 1K vectors) that would reduce tickets.
miguel: I can handle the conversion table and the billing wording. I'll also add a short callout: "If you're migrating from the old billing keys, convert X to Y."
elliot: I can take the rate-limit payload update + SDK snippet examples for JS/Python. Small snippet idea:```js
// prefer retry_after_ms (ms), fallback to retry_after (s)
const body = await resp.json();
const waitMs = body.retry_after_ms ?? (body.retry_after ? body.retry_after * 1000 : null);
if (waitMs) await sleep(waitMs);
```
elliot: Python:```py
body = resp.json()
wait_ms = body.get('retry_after_ms') or (body.get('retry_after') and body['retry_after'] * 1000)
if wait_ms:
    time.sleep(wait_ms / 1000)
```
eng-qa-bot: QA-check: remember to add unit tests for the sample snippets in `docs/tests/snippets` so CI runs them.
sara_docs: good catch, I'll add tests. For the dashboard screenshots, should we replace with an embedded live image (png) from the console or just update links to the new path `https://console.redwood.ai/usage/billing/tiers`?
miguel: update links and replace one screenshot with a small annotated SVG that highlights `requests_per_tier`. I can produce that.
tara_support: also add a short note: "Billing Viewer role is required to see per-tier breakouts." saves a lot of "can't access" tickets.
sara_docs: will add that. I'm going to open one consolidated PR with three commits: (1) billing units + conversion table, (2) rate limit payload + snippets + tests, (3) dashboard link + SVG replacement. PR description will include follow-ups for infra: expose `burst_used` metric and add `requests_per_tier` alert.
